about: Writer-to-reader registry for backup/export paths (#3680). Every backup/export writer in this repo is a row here: each row names its restore reader and its round-trip test, or records restorable: false with the reason. Enforced by tests/backup-writer-registry.test.js (the CI closure check): a writer row without a reader and a round-trip test fails, a restorable: false row without a reason fails, and any backup/export-named file under server/, cloudflare/ or scripts/ that is neither a row artefact nor a named as-read exception below fails. Seeded from the 2026-10-15 margin audit's 13 backup/export paths (strategy-2026-10/margin-audit-2026-10-15.md), re-censused at the seed base below: the audit's writer paths map to rows W1-W5, its reader/test/fleet rows are the readers and tests named inside those rows, and one writer landed since the audit (W6, room-shard copy). The R2 row (W2) absorbs PR #3622's lone R2_BACKUP_RESTORABLE = false flag (#3585) as a checked registry row; #3622 itself is untouched. Semantic round-trip assertions (flags stay flags, authority fields match real members, secrets restore as true values or revoked) are the #3680 PREP remainder and are NOT claimed by this registry: the round-trip tests named here are the existing byte/parity/replay tests. Format follows PR #4067's registry-of-registries manifest (scripts/registry-manifest.json): the registryOfRegistriesRow below is this registry's row in that manifest's registries[] shape, ready to paste in when #4067 lands.

asRead.reason: Analytics CSV download exporter (user-facing data export with its own sinks); it writes no store backup and has no restore reader by design
Pure CSV rendering helper for downloads; not a backup writer and nothing restores from it
Human-readable HTML rendering of the per-room export (W5); a document for people, not a restorable format - the JSONL form is the round-trip format
Workerd proof harness for GET /api/operator/export (W3); a checker of the writer, not a writer
Browser check harness for the room export surface (W5); a checker, not a writer

census.rule: Every file under a census root whose basename contains a census token is a writer path, a reader, an artefact of a row below, or a named as-read exception. tests/backup-writer-registry.test.js recomputes this set on every run.

registryOfRegistriesRow.canary: tests/backup-writer-registry.test.js removes the reader from a registry copy and requires the check to fail; a restorable: false row without a reason must also fail
registryOfRegistriesRow.closureStatus: closed for writer/reader/test presence; semantic round-trip assertions are the #3680 PREP remainder and stay open there
registryOfRegistriesRow.derivedOrHand: hand-seeded from the 2026-10-15 margin audit's 13 paths, re-censused at seedBase; census-checked by the closure test
registryOfRegistriesRow.enumerates: Every backup/export writer path, its restore reader (or restorable: false with reason), and its round-trip test
registryOfRegistriesRow.lastFailure: none recorded in-tree as of 2026-10-24 (born with this manifest)
registryOfRegistriesRow.name: Backup/export writer-to-reader registry
registryOfRegistriesRow.sourceOfTruth: scripts/backup-writer-registry.json, derived by the writer census in tests/backup-writer-registry.test.js

writers.format: NDJSON export stored as <=16 MiB KV parts plus a manifest written last (manifest version 2)
writers.name: Nightly whole-store backup, Workers KV target
writers.notes: The production nightly path (margin audit row 1, chunked-safe; proven end-to-end at 90,688,789 bytes on 2026-10-15, #3409). writeDailyBackup in the writer module dispatches to this writer when no R2 binding wins; the in-product reader for the same KV copy is POST /api/operator/restore-from-backup (server/restore-ndjson.mjs operatorRestoreFromBackupResponse, listed as an artefact), and scripts/restore-room-backup.mjs --kv is the operator reader named here.

writers.format: Single R2 object per day, whole export buffered in Durable Object memory before one bucket.put
writers.name: Nightly whole-store backup, R2 target
writers.notes: Margin audit rows 2-3 (breaks-at-cap, dormant; reader missing). Dormant today: production cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc binds KV only, and R2 is not enabled on the account (docs/BACKUPS.md, code 10042).
writers.unrestorableReason: No restore path can read an R2 backup: the Durable Object restore endpoint takes a KV handle only and scripts/restore-room-backup.mjs reads KV or a local file only; the sole R2 read in the repo is the writer's own bucket.head skip check (#3585). The writer also buffers the entire ~90 MB export in Durable Object memory against the 128 MB limit. This row absorbs PR #3622's lone R2_BACKUP_RESTORABLE = false flag as a checked registry row: flip restorable to true only in the change that ships an R2 restore reader (and the chunked R2 writer), naming both here.

writers.format: Streamed NDJSON: watermark line, one {table, row} line per row, trailer line with event count and events hash; secret columns sha256-sanitized under BACKUP_SANITIZE_POLICY 2
writers.name: Operator whole-store NDJSON export (GET /api/operator/export)
writers.notes: Margin audit row 6 (chunked-safe, streaming). The same NDJSON format the nightly writers (W1/W2) store. File readers: scripts/replay-room-export.mjs (replayNdjson from the writer module) and scripts/restore-room-backup.mjs --from. The request-body restore endpoint (server/restore-ndjson.mjs operatorRestoreResponse, RESTORE_MAX_BYTES 64 MiB, margin audit row 4, already dead above the cap) is a second reader of this row's format, not a writer.

writers.format: node:sqlite backup() file copy plus a watermark sidecar carrying content digests (REL-14)
writers.name: On-disk sqlite file backup (Node server)
writers.notes: Margin audit row 9 (not a body path: disk-to-disk). scripts/backup-room.mjs is the CLI entry, deploy/project-room-backup.service/.timer schedule it, scripts/backup-drill.mjs exercises it on a local room, and scripts/restore-rehearsal.mjs rehearses opening the restored copy; the reader named here recomputes the watermark digests on the restored copy so a same-count edit or flipped file byte fails verification.

writers.format: JSONL, one {sequence, event} line per visible event, sequences renumbered densely for reimport
writers.name: Per-room event export (GET /api/rooms/:id/export)
writers.notes: Margin audit row 10 (bounded-safe: one room's log, capped at 10,000 events by design). The route surface lives in server/http.mjs (export and import routes, import capped at 8 MiB per margin audit row 11); the writer and reader are the store methods named here. The HTML rendering of the same export (server/room-export-html.mjs) is a human document, not a restorable format - see asRead.

writers.format: Per-room NDJSON slice (watermark, room-table rows, trailer) written by the room-shard stack
writers.name: Room-shard copy: per-room NDJSON slice for shard homes
writers.notes: New since the 2026-10-15 margin audit (room-shard stack, landed 2026-10-23/24): found by this lane's re-census at the seed base, not by the filename census (the module name carries neither token), and registered here so the shard backup path cannot drift out of the registry. Its round-trip test asserts a room slice restores verified with a matching room home digest, and that a whole-store export is refused by the slice reader.
